title: The position takes from four traditions and is none of them

statements.text: From Platonism it keeps realism and geometric scaffolding, from process philosophy the primacy of activity, from Aristotle form as activity, and from structural realism the reality of structure. It rejects pre-given structure, pure flux, substance as the primary category, and strong substrate-neutrality.

sources.quote: Constitutive Geometric Projection is its own position, located at coordinates none of the named traditions occupy.
